first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A group of multiple spectators behind the barrier on the left side of the track; spectators at different locations are not treated as the same group of individuals.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person in the first-person foreground who is wearing black long sleeves and white gloves and controlling Vehicle A.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The mountain bicycle controlled by Person B, with a black flat handlebar, front wheel, cables, and a red front component visible.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The narrow light-brown platform surface against the wall and the wider gray downhill road to which it leads.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: The gray tubular-frame barrier sections in front of the spectators on the left and the dark vertical-bar fence atop the wall on the right.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The silver-gray graffiti wall, exposed brick and light-colored wall sections, and irregular stone wall passed on the right side of the track.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The building with a blue exterior wall behind the spectators and the low-rise building ahead with a reddish-brown roof.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The blue sky exposed above the buildings and the fence atop the wall.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: The dense shrubs on the left side of the starting platform and the later local clusters of green leaves beside and atop the wall.

entities.name: utility poles along the route
entities.identification: The slender upright poles beside the buildings and road that connect to overhead lines, some with small attached outlines.

entities.name: cables along the route
entities.identification: The dark overhead lines crossing the sky in the upper part of the image and converging near the upright poles.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: In this segment, Vehicle B refers to the group consisting of two light-colored parked cars high in the upper right, behind the barrier atop the wall; they are first partially exposed in frame 9, and both cars are clear in frame 19.

entities.name: strip of bare soil beside the road
entities.identification: The yellowish-brown area between the curb and the stone wall on the right side of the gray sloping road in the later portion.

entities.name: distant blue water surface
entities.identification: The dark-blue strip of water surface partially exposed behind the distant buildings and rooftops.
